definitions.gloss: livestock industry; animal husbandry (as an industry)
definitions.explanation: The industry of raising domestic animals such as cattle, pigs, and chickens for meat, milk, eggs, and other products. One branch of agriculture.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{畜産業|ちくさんぎょう}が{盛|さか}んだ。
examples.english: The livestock industry is thriving in this region.

examples.japanese: {飼料|しりょう}の{値上|ねあ}がりが{畜産業|ちくさんぎょう}を{圧迫|あっぱく}している。
examples.english: Rising feed prices are squeezing the livestock industry.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}は{代々|だいだい}{畜産業|ちくさんぎょう}を{営|いとな}み、{乳牛|にゅうぎゅう}を{育|そだ}てている。
examples.english: My family has run a livestock business for generations, raising dairy cows.

notes:
Composed of {畜産|ちくさん} (livestock raising) + {業|ぎょう} (industry, business).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {畜産業|ちくさんぎょう}が{盛|さか}んだ: the livestock industry is thriving
- {畜産業|ちくさんぎょう}を{営|いとな}む: to run a livestock business

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {農業|のうぎょう}: agriculture — broader; growing crops as well as raising animals
- {酪農|らくのう}: dairy farming — a specific branch focused on milk-producing animals
